claim: The 2021 System Installation Guide says the laser safety switch, once pressed, stays in the disabled position until released by turning it counter-clockwise.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 11 (PDF page 15). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. THIS DISAGREES with the 2022 Laser Safety Manual, which says clockwise (tweez_laser_safety_switch_stops_emission). The person ruled that the safety guide follows the 2022 edition; this entry keeps the other reading so it is not rediscovered as new. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
